versions.content: {DRAFT} Upon reception of a SYNC (or OFS) message, if • the message is not the first SYNC (or OFS) message after startup • and Sequence Counter check is enabled (i.e., CanTSynGlobalTimeSe- quenceCounterJumpWidth > 0) • and the Time Domain is not in timeout (i.e., TIMEOUT bit not set in Time Base synchronization status timeBaseStatus ), then a Time Slave shall check the difference value between the Sequence Counter of the current message and the Sequence Counter of the previous SYNC (or respectively OFS) message. If the difference value is greater than 0 and less or equal than CanTSynGlobalTime- SequenceCounterJumpWidth , then a Time Slave shall consider the Sequence Counter value as valid, else as invalid.
